CONTINUO — Florence 1602, Caccini's Le nuove musiche: polyphony
deliberately REFUSED. One voice, affect first, the chords reduced to an
accompaniment a harpsichord realizes from figures — and under it the
lamento tetrachord, falling by step, the bass line the whole Baroque
will cry over. The violone is the bass chair's own acoustic_bass,
honestly close.

"opera seria" CAME OFF THIS LIST 2026-08-29 WITHOUT BEING PAID:
the row asked for it as an ancestor and it is this music's
GRANDCHILD — London 1724 is an anchor now and its parents point
back HERE at dominant weight, which is the same fact with the
arrow the right way round. A 1602 record cannot descend from
1724; the parlor/ragtime rule, applied on arrival.

the lamento tetrachord
